I've noticed this. They are most likely using a nosql cluster. At any rate the data needs to be replicated to all the nosql nodes in the cluster and sometimes that can take quite a while. Also during certain operations especially when nodes turn off, spin up/spin down, fail, or get removed from the cluster the most current data can fail to replicate to the other nodes and get over written by stale data.
